Juno (CS): Mina at LighthouseAI requested APAC enable + short demo burst next Mon. Needs ap-southeast-1 pin, IPs 203.0.113.7/32 and 198.51.100.9/32, CORS https://present.lighthouse.ai, qps=220 for 2.5h (2026-04-06 13:30-16:00 SGT). Scoped demo key model=v1.3, retention=0. Can infra/security confirm? @Cal @Rex @Pri
Mina (LighthouseAI): Confirming. We'll have ~18 participants, streaming on. Token should expire 4h after window and only allow generate calls.
Cal (Eng Infra): We can pin tenant=lighthouseai and create a reserved pool in ap-southeast-1 with failover to ap-northeast-1. For 220 qps + streaming, reserve 2x g4dn; recommend autoscale min=2 max=3.
Rex (SRE): Reserving 2 nodes now, autoscale min=2 max=4, trigger p95 latency>650ms. Staging ACL updated with given IPs. Will push to prod after signed demo AUP.
Pri (Security): We'll require signed AUP and security addendum. Token will be scoped to the two /32s, model=v1.3, expire=2026-04-06T20:00:00Z, retention=0, and disable request bodies in logs. Opening SEC ticket.
Juno (CS): Sending AUP + one-page addendum to Mina now — need it signed by EOD today to issue token 24h before demo. Sales marked this as "renewal focus"; good demo could accelerate renewal talks.
ops-bot: Route reservation created: route-lighthouseai-ap-southeast-1 queued at 6129876548 by Rex (SRE)
Rex (SRE): I'll monitor during the demo and set alerts for cpu>70%, p95 latency>700ms, error-rate>0.5%. Ping #eng-sre if anything spikes.
Mina (LighthouseAI): Signing now, will upload to the secure share and ping Juno. Appreciate the support!
Juno (CS): Thanks team — once signed I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over the scoped demo key. Good luck!
